summary: GLM-5.2 third-mode integration validated. 122/124 tests pass across 8 test files (test_ai_mode 19 + test_ai_mode_three_modes 17 new + test_admin_ai_mode_http 8 + test_surgical_fixes 26 + test_surgical_fixes_v2 24 + test_openai_param_compat 12 + test_intent_scope_fix 5 + test_pre_finish_gate 6, minus 2 failures from one identical root cause). Module-level ai_mode.py is correct on every dimension. Source introspection on freebuild_agent.py confirms zhipu_glm routing + AsyncOpenAI base_url='https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/'. Cross-key isolation verified: hybrid_gpt with only ZHIPU_API_KEY correctly falls back to Claude (NOT silently substitutes GLM). The only failure is one real backend bug in server.py: the HTTP PUT route rejects the legacy 'hybrid' alias with 400 because it does an early VALID_MODES check BEFORE delegating to set_ai_mode (which would normalize the alias). This breaks the explicit requirement that PUT {mode:'hybrid'} must return 200 + 'hybrid_gpt'.

critical.issue: Body {mode:'hybrid'} returns 400 ('mode must be one of [...]') instead of 200 with body {mode:'hybrid_gpt'}. The legacy alias is correctly handled inside ai_mode.set_ai_mode() (it accepts 'hybrid' and normalizes to 'hybrid_gpt') BUT server.py lines 2136-2138 do a hard `if mode not in VALID_MODES: raise HTTPException(400)` BEFORE calling set_ai_mode, so the alias never reaches normalization. Any admin who previously saved 'hybrid' will hit a 400 when the FE re-PUTs that value. Fix: either (a) accept LEGACY_HYBRID_ALIAS in the route check and pass it through to set_ai_mode which will normalize, or (b) catch ValueError from set_ai_mode and let the module decide. Suggested patch at /app/backend/server.py:2136 — replace the early check with: `from modules.freebuild.ai_mode import LEGACY_HYBRID_ALIAS; if mode != LEGACY_HYBRID_ALIAS and mode not in VALID_MODES: raise HTTPException(400, ...); await set_ai_mode(db, mode); normalized = 'hybrid_gpt' if mode == LEGACY_HYBRID_ALIAS else mode; return {'ok': True, 'mode': normalized}`.

rca of the issue: Root cause: ai_mode.set_ai_mode() was correctly extended to accept the legacy 'hybrid' alias and normalize to 'hybrid_gpt' (line 82-83 of ai_mode.py), but the HTTP route in server.py was NOT updated to mirror this — it still does a raw `if mode not in VALID_MODES: raise HTTPException(400)` at line 2137 which rejects 'hybrid' before set_ai_mode is ever called. Reproduction: `curl -X PUT $BACKEND/api/admin/ai-mode -H 'Authorization: Bearer <owner_token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"mode":"hybrid"}'` → 400 instead of 200. Mitigation: in server.py:2136-2140, treat LEGACY_HYBRID_ALIAS as a valid input — either (a) explicitly allow it in the guard and pass through to set_ai_mode (which normalizes), or (b) remove the early guard and rely on set_ai_mode to raise ValueError which then maps to 400. The second approach is cleaner (single source of truth in ai_mode.py).
